raw: SELECT dz.zone FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id JOIN zones dz ON t.do_location_id = dz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Manhattan' AND dz.zone IN ('JFK Airport') GROUP BY dz.zone ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT dz.zone FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id JOIN zones dz ON t.do_location_id = dz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Manhattan' AND dz.zone IN ('JFK Airport') GROUP BY dz.zone ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

raw: SELECT pz.zone, SUM(t.tip_amount) AS total_tip FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Brooklyn' GROUP BY pz.zone ORDER BY total_tip DESC LIMIT 3
sql: SELECT pz.zone, SUM(t.tip_amount) AS total_tip FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Brooklyn' GROUP BY pz.zone ORDER BY total_tip DESC LIMIT 3

raw: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN dz.zone IN ('JFK Airport', 'LaGuardia Airport', 'Newark Airport') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id JOIN zones dz ON t.do_location_id = dz.location_id WHERE t.trip_distance > 20
